prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Gustavo, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Gustavo thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a total war on residents next month with insane, mandatory fines for even a second of delay. They’re basically turning our streets into a police state, so expect them to be hunting for any excuse to ticket us."
text: I’ll believe it when I see it, but Mrs. Higgins says they’re already marking bins on Oak Street with chalk. The council really needs to stop this nonsense and just enforce a stricter schedule instead of issuing these fines.
